title: Show a yearly cycle as a rose
description: A rose gives each month a wedge whose reach is its value, so the cycle reads as one shape around the clock.
version: 0.0.1
styles: [scientific]
---

## Rain peaks in July

These illustrative rainfall totals give each month a wedge, clockwise from January at 12 o'clock. A wedge reaches out in proportion to its value from a zero centre.

```chart
type: rose
title: Rain peaks in July
subtitle: Rainfall per month
data:
  inline:
    - {month: Jan, mm: 30}
    - {month: Feb, mm: 25}
    - {month: Mar, mm: 40}
    - {month: Apr, mm: 55}
    - {month: May, mm: 80}
    - {month: Jun, mm: 95}
    - {month: Jul, mm: 110}
    - {month: Aug, mm: 100}
    - {month: Sep, mm: 70}
    - {month: Oct, mm: 50}
    - {month: Nov, mm: 45}
    - {month: Dec, mm: 35}
encoding: {x: month, y: mm}
axes:
  y: {label: Rainfall (mm)}
```

*Source: Illustrative values.*

Use the keyboard or pointer to read each month's total.
